question: How many customers do we have in the APAC region?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE region_id = 'APAC'

question: What is the list price of the QV-PU200?
gold_sql: SELECT list_price_usd FROM products WHERE sku = 'QV-PU200'

question: How many orders were cancelled in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', ordered_on) = '2025'

question: List the SKUs of the discontinued products.
gold_sql: SELECT sku FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1

question: How many support tickets are still open?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_on IS NULL

question: How many enterprise customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise'

question: Which product has the highest list price? Give its SKU.
gold_sql: SELECT sku FROM products ORDER BY list_price_usd DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders came in through the partner channel in Q1 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'partner' AND ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question: How many urgent support tickets were opened in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND strftime('%Y', opened_on) = '2025'

question: When was the QV-EM300 launched?
gold_sql: SELECT launched_on FROM products WHERE sku = 'QV-EM300'

question: How many people work in the Support department?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Support'

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', signed_up_on) = '2024'

question: What is the average list price of the Tide product line?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(list_price_usd) FROM products WHERE line = 'Tide'

question: How many orders have been returned in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned'

question: How many employees were hired in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE strftime('%Y', hired_on) = '2025'

question: List the SKUs of all products in the Pro tier.
gold_sql: SELECT sku FROM products WHERE tier = 'Pro'

question: How many support tickets are in the calibration category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE category = 'calibration'

question: How many products have a list price above 1,000 USD?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE list_price_usd > 1000

question: How many orders did Halvorsen Marine place in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.company_name = 'Halvorsen Marine' AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025'

question: What was the total revenue from customers in the UK in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_id = 'UK' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025'

question: Which customer opened the most support tickets? Give the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of the QV-VN300 were sold in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.sku = 'QV-VN300' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025'

question: How many support tickets were filed about Ember products?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets t JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id WHERE p.line = 'Ember'

question: Which region placed the most orders in Q1 2026? Give the region id.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY c.region_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of EU companies that have at least one returned order.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region_id = 'EU' AND o.status = 'returned'

question: How many distinct customers ordered a Max-tier product in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.tier = 'Max' AND o.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'

question: How many units of Pulse products were sold through the web channel?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.line = 'Pulse' AND o.channel = 'web' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

question: How many employees does each region have? Give region id and count.
gold_sql: SELECT region_id, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY region_id

question: Which product line had the most high or urgent priority tickets in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT p.line FROM support_tickets t JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id WHERE t.priority IN ('high', 'urgent') AND strftime('%Y', t.opened_on) = '2025' GROUP BY p.line ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders from smb customers were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'smb' AND o.status = 'cancelled'

question: What was the revenue of the QV-TD200 in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.sku = 'QV-TD200' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025'

question: Which APAC customers have never placed an order? Give the company names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region_id = 'APAC' AND o.order_id IS NULL

question: How many support tickets about the QV-PU100 are still open?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets t JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id WHERE p.sku = 'QV-PU100' AND t.closed_on IS NULL

question: How many order lines were on orders from enterprise customers in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'

question: How many orders contained the QV-PU200?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.sku = 'QV-PU200'

question: Which company placed order 1042?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id = 1042

question: What was the total revenue per region in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY c.region_id

question: What were the top 3 products by units sold in 2025? Give the SKUs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.sku FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders were placed in each month of the first half of 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_on), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question: What is the average resolution time, in days, of closed urgent tickets?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(closed_on) - julianday(opened_on)) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND closed_on IS NOT NULL

question: How many orders did each channel bring in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY channel

question: Which customers generated more than 150,000 USD of revenue in 2025? Give the company names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) > 150000

question: What percentage of the orders placed in 2025 were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', ordered_on) = '2025'

question: What was the average order value in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) AS v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: Which product line generated the most revenue in 2026 so far?
gold_sql: SELECT p.line FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.line ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many support tickets were opened in each category in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE strftime('%Y', opened_on) = '2025' GROUP BY category

question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue? Answer as YYYY-MM.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_on) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have placed more than 60 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 60)

question: What was the revenue per customer segment in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment

question: How many units of each tier were sold in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT p.tier, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY p.tier

question: Which 5 customers had the highest revenue in 2025? Give the company names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many employees are in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: By what percentage did revenue grow from 2024 to 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (r25 - r24) / r24 FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.ordered_on) = '2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_usd END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped'))

question: Among customers who opened at least one support ticket, what is the average number of tickets per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets GROUP BY customer_id)
